scope: Read-only original Face_SKIN measurement; landmarks are manually reviewed model-semantic proxies, not automatic anatomical recognition. No derived model/recipe admission.
coordinateSystem: Original exported glTF metres: +Y up, -Z forward. Blender Face local uses +Z up,+Y forward.

proposedEndpoint.formula: Original Basis graph fixed once. weight=1 for d<=2mm, smoothstep falloff to 0 at d>=8mm; absolute shapes translate by -Z * .5mm * weight.
proposedEndpoint.rangeStatus: Proposal only; no exported endpoint or signed range validated.

limits: Alar landmarks are stylized sidewall proxies; no actual nostril hole is asserted.
Geodesic support is proposed from original topology; no geometry is mutated/exported here.
Current glasses fit band excludes this small support if margin positive, but no accessory contact or rendered appearance is certified.
